package com.competitive.clan.models;

/**
 * Classification of a CLAN_MESSAGE broadcast, matched against known substrings in
 * Jagex's broadcast text.
 */
public enum SystemMessageType
{
	DROP,
	RAID_DROP,
	PET_DROP,
	COLLECTION_LOG,
	PERSONAL_BEST,
	CLUE_DROP,
	QUEST,
	LEVEL_UP,
	COMBAT_ACHIEVEMENT,
	DIARY,
	PVP_KILL,
	ATTENDANCE,
	UNKNOWN
}
